> from there title becomes a bit more obvious for me, or I these days ask AI

Same. I've been giving my AI editor my drafts with working titles, and the intelligence reads the words from a different perspective. 

In addition to sentence structure, grammar, and flow, my AI editor often iterates on tying the title in with the overall structure of the piece.

Its first observation is almost always, "the full draft doesn't quite deliver on the promise of the title, how about a short bridge to bring the reader along to where you want to take them?"
